Maria G: morning — handing off to Sam for the day. quick snapshot:
Maria G: Deploys: rolling deploy of routing-svc finished at 03:40 UTC. no rollout errors in prod, but two pods in eu-west restarted once.
Maria G: Watch: embed cache (eu-west-1) saw a TTL churn spike ~02:15, KV evictions up ~3x. I bumped default TTL to 3h for high-traffic keys. could still observe transient 503s for long-tail requests.
Maria G: If you see 99th pct tail latency > 800ms, try toggling the canary to v2 (route: /models/embed-v2) and open a trace link.
Maria G: Quick check command:
Maria G: ```
Maria G: # check recent evictions
Maria G: curl -s http://metrics.internal/kv/evictions?region=eu-west | jq '.last_2h'
Maria G: ```
Maria G: Oncall-bot scheduled an automated canary rollback at 12:30 UTC if error-rate > 1.5% on /embed.* endpoints.
Sam V: Thanks — copying some notes into my watchlist. I'll be available until 20:00 UTC.
Sam V: I'll also keep an eye on the prefetch service; latency rose after the TTL change in staging earlier.
Jordan K: I'll take PR #4321 (batcher backpressure) and push a tiny fix if tests are green. ping me if you want it hotfixed.
Maria G: thx Jordan — left a short comment on the PR about the metric name; should be safe to ship behind feature flag.
Sam V: Flag for folks: fyi about a customer report from APAC — occasional 429s hitting private dedicated pools last night. not widespread, but keeping an eye.
Sam V: If 429s correlate with prefetch spikes, consider temporarily reducing burst_limit to 80% for that pool.
oncall-bot: Reminder: canary rollback check scheduled at 12:30 UTC for thread 3778901234. Conditions: error-rate > 1.5% for 10m.
Maria G: Action items for Sam: 1) monitor eu-west KV evictions and tail latency 2) keep canary threshold dashboard open 3) escalate to infra if pod restarts exceed 5 in 30m
Sam V: Got it — will update thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Jordan K: if I can't get to the PR in 30m I'll leave it for Sam to merge behind the flag.
Maria G: thanks all. leaving runbook links below:
Maria G: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Maria G: https://dashboards.internal/embed-latency?refresh=1m
Sam V: acknowledged — handing over to me. enjoy your weekend, Maria :coffee:
Maria G: have a good one!
